MW-ENG-01  .  commissioning scratch notes (contractor handover)
================================================================

Row A supply VFD is a Schneider ATV630 on the control network
(Modbus/TCP, unit id 1). The old custom helper scripts were pulled at
handover -- use the standard tools that are already on this box:
the pymodbus console and mbpoll.

Device identity (ATV630)
  - The basic identity read comes back almost empty. Don't stop there.
  - Do an EXTENDED identity read (read code 3). The value that matters is
    the private vendor object: 0x80 = 128.

Nameplate / asset data
  - Lives in the 87xx holding registers on this node. Sweep that block
    and read whatever is in it.

Addressing gotcha
  - This drive is zero-based on the wire. With mbpoll you MUST pass -0,
    or every address lands one register off and you chase ghosts.

(Commanding registers for the fan are NOT written down here -- get the
current speed/command map from the site commissioning record or the
vendor manual.)
